segments.name: Supply Technologies
segments.description: Provides supply chain management outsourcing of production components and manufactures precision cold-formed and cold-extruded fasteners for OEM customers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates through three reportable segments: Supply Technologies, Assembly Components and Engineered Products.

segments.name: Assembly Components
segments.description: Designs and manufactures fuel efficiency, reduced emissions and vehicle electrification products for worldwide car manufacturers.
segments.evidence: Assembly Components manufactures products oriented towards fuel efficiency, reduced emissions and vehicle electrification.

segments.name: Engineered Products
segments.description: Designs and manufactures highly engineered capital equipment and forged and machined products for metals, oil and gas, aerospace, rail and other industries.
segments.evidence: Our Engineered Products segment operates a diverse group of niche manufacturing businesses that design and manufacture a broad range of highly engineered products, including induction heating and melting systems, pipe threading systems and forged and machined products.

revenueModel.text: Customers, primarily OEMs, pay the company under sole-source contracts for supply chain management services, manufactured components and capital equipment.
revenueModel.evidence: Total Supply Management ™ is typically provided to customers pursuant to sole-source arrangements.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company sold its Aluminum Products business, which is classified as a discontinued operation.
changes.evidence: On December 29, 2023, the Company completed the sale of its Aluminum Products business, which has been classified as a discontinued operation for all periods presented.
